gloss: part of, link in a chain

definitions.gloss: part of, link in a chain
definitions.explanation: One component or phase within a larger connected series of actions, plans, or processes. Emphasizes that the item in question is not isolated but belongs to a broader whole.

examples.japanese: ⟦{教育|きょういく}→教育：01313_kyouiku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{一環|いっかん}⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧⟦{行|おこな}う→行う：01238_okonau⟧。
examples.english: Carry out as part of education.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{活動|かつどう}→活動：00201_katsudou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{地域|ちいき}→地域：01461_chiiki⟧づくり⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{一環|いっかん}です。
examples.english: This activity is part of community development.

examples.japanese: ⟦{健康|けんこう}→健康：02706_kenkou⟧⟦{促進|そくしん}→促進：05632_sokushin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{一環|いっかん}⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧、⟦{会社|かいしゃ}→会社：00607_kaisha⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ヨガ→ヨガ：04737_yoga⟧⟦{教室|きょうしつ}→教室：00794_kyoushitsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{開|ひら}いている→開く：01979_hiraku⟧。
examples.english: As part of health promotion, the company is running yoga classes.

notes:
{一環|いっかん} literally means "one ring" or "one link" in a chain. It is almost always used in the pattern 〜⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{一環|いっかん}⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧ (as part of ~).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- 〜⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{一環|いっかん}⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧ (as part of ~)
- 〜⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{一環|いっかん}⟦である→である：09855_dearu⟧ (to be part of ~)
- ⟦{政策|せいさく}→政策：10070_seisaku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{一環|いっかん} (part of a policy)
- ⟦{研修|けんしゅう}→研修：05322_kenshuu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{一環|いっかん} (part of training)
- ⟦{取|と}り{組|く}み→取り組み：10403_torikumi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{一環|いっかん} (part of an initiative)

USAGE:
- Almost exclusively used with ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{一環|いっかん}⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧ or ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{一環|いっかん}で
- Commonly found in formal and written Japanese, especially news and business contexts
- Not to be confused with ⟦{一貫|いっかん}→一貫：17700_ikkan_b⟧ (consistency, throughout), which has the same reading but different meaning
